model.schaden_claims.src_claims_cases.name: src_claims_cases
model.schaden_claims.src_claims_cases.description: Cleaned claim cases with harmonised status and reporting delay.
model.schaden_claims.src_claims_cases.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    claim_id,
    contract_id,
    risk_code,
    loss_date,
    report_date,
    date_diff(report_date, loss_date, day)  as reporting_delay_days,
    lower(claim_status)                     as claim_status,
    reserve_amount                          as reserve_chf,
    load_ts                                 as _loaded_at
from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
where loss_date is not null

model.schaden_claims.src_claims_payments.name: src_claims_payments
model.schaden_claims.src_claims_payments.description: Cleaned claim payments with signed amounts per payment type.
model.schaden_claims.src_claims_payments.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    payment_id,
    claim_id,
    payment_date,
    upper(payment_type)                                        as payment_type,
    case when upper(payment_type) = 'RECOVERY'
         then -abs(amount) else abs(amount) end                as amount_chf,
    load_ts                                                    as _loaded_at
from {{ source('raw_claims', 'payments') }}

model.schaden_claims.int_claims_payments.name: int_claims_payments
model.schaden_claims.int_claims_payments.description: Payments aggregated per claim and payment type, incrementally loaded.
model.schaden_claims.int_claims_payments.compiled_code:
select
    claim_id,
    payment_type,
    count(*)            as payment_count,

model.schaden_claims.int_claims_loss_rat.name: int_claims_loss_ratio
model.schaden_claims.int_claims_loss_rat.description: Loss ratio per product and canton, combining claims with the portfolio snapshot.
model.schaden_claims.int_claims_loss_rat.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with claims as (
    select
        cs.product_code,
        cs.canton,
        cs.risk_code,
        count(distinct cs.claim_id)                as claim_count,
        sum(cs.reserve_chf)                        as reserve_chf,
        sum(coalesce(pm.paid_chf, 0))              as paid_chf
    from {{ ref('int_claims_cases') }} cs
    left join {{ ref('int_claims_payments') }} pm using (claim_id)
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

portfolio as (
    select product_code, canton, risk_code, sum(written_premium_chf) as written_premium_chf
    from {{ ref('src_claims_mfp_portfolio') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    c.product_code,
    c.canton,
    c.risk_code,
    c.claim_count,
    c.paid_chf,
    c.reserve_chf,
    p.written_premium_chf,
    safe_divide(c.paid_chf + c.reserve_chf, p.written_premium_chf) as loss_ratio
from claims c
left join portfolio p using (product_code, canton, risk_code)

model.schaden_claims.out_claims_kpi_dail.name: out_claims_kpi_daily
model.schaden_claims.out_claims_kpi_dail.description: Daily claims KPI table for the management dashboard.
model.schaden_claims.out_claims_kpi_dail.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='incremental', unique_key='snapshot_date') }}

select
    current_date()                  as snapshot_date,
    product_code,
    canton,
    sum(claim_count)                as claim_count,
    sum(paid_chf)                   as paid_chf,
    sum(reserve_chf)                as reserve_chf,
    safe_divide(sum(paid_chf) + sum(reserve_chf),
                sum(written_premium_chf)) as loss_ratio
from {{ ref('int_claims_loss_ratio') }}
group by 1, 2, 3

model.schaden_claims.out_claims_reserve_.description: Reserve development per loss year for the actuarial department.
model.schaden_claims.out_claims_reserve_.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

    extract(year from cs.loss_date)      as loss_year,
    cs.product_code,

    count(distinct cs.claim_id)          as claim_count,
    sum(cs.reserve_chf)                  as reserve_chf,

    avg(cs.reporting_delay_days)         as avg_reporting_delay_days
from {{ ref('int_claims_cases') }} cs
left join {{ ref('int_claims_payments') }} pm using (claim_id)
group by 1, 2, 3

model.schaden_claims.out_pnc_combined_ra.name: out_pnc_combined_ratio
model.schaden_claims.out_pnc_combined_ra.description: Combined ratio per product: joins the claims loss ratio with the premium report.
model.schaden_claims.out_pnc_combined_ra.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with loss as (
    select product_code,
           sum(paid_chf + reserve_chf) as incurred_chf,
           sum(written_premium_chf)    as written_premium_chf
    from {{ ref('int_claims_loss_ratio') }}
    group by 1
),

premium as (
    select product_code, technical_premium_chf, annual_premium_chf, premium_adequacy_ratio
    from {{ ref('src_claims_mfp_premium') }}
)

select
    l.product_code,
    l.incurred_chf,
    l.written_premium_chf,
    p.technical_premium_chf,
    p.premium_adequacy_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf, l.written_premium_chf)              as loss_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf * 0.28, l.written_premium_chf)       as expense_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf * 1.28, l.written_premium_chf)       as combined_ratio
from loss l
left join premium p using (product_code)
model.schaden_claims.out_pnc_combined_ra.compiled_code:
with loss as (
    select product_code,
           sum(paid_chf + reserve_chf) as incurred_chf,
           sum(written_premium_chf)    as written_premium_chf
    from `pnc-analytics-prd`.claims_intermediate.int_claims_loss_ratio
    group by 1
),
premium as (
    select product_code, technical_premium_chf, annual_premium_chf, premium_adequacy_ratio
    from `pnc-analytics-prd`.claims_source.src_claims_mfp_premium
)
select
    l.product_code,
    l.incurred_chf,
    l.written_premium_chf,
    p.technical_premium_chf,
    p.premium_adequacy_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf, l.written_premium_chf)              as loss_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf * 0.28, l.written_premium_chf)       as expense_ratio,
    safe_divide(l.incurred_chf * 1.28, l.written_premium_chf)       as combined_ratio
from loss l
left join premium p using (product_code)
